content: I am looking for more aspects that would be needed in https://github.com/cobord/jordanalgebra. There are already the formally real jordan algebras including Albert Algebra. I decided to punt on the case of characteristic 2 not thinking it was worth it. But that just be what I think of as the intended applications and am happy to hear if anyone wants those complications. Derivations and structure lie rings are present too but they do not connect to any named lie rings. Again I don't know if that is something someone wants.
Are you aware of docs#IsCommJordan in mathlib? It looks like you defined JordanAlgebra without reference to it

It was because those were prop valued that I did not prefer that method. Had some issues around that. That one just had the Basic file. I was not planning on contributing this so it would not be any issue of backwards compatibility like if I had PRed
